reviewer_label: AI review subagent; not human expert ground truth
methodology: Read only the four blinded packets for candidate/source evidence and frozen required findings. No plans, masks, arm mappings, costs, judge outputs or other answers were inspected.
All four cases challenge a proposed conclusion. None is designated a positive control. These invented cases form a synthetic pilot, not human validation.
Each candidate is evaluated across its answer, findings, limitations and next_steps. Substantive semantic coverage determines met; partial coverage is described in reason when false.

Unsupported material claims and contradictions are separate from omissions and citation fidelity. Honest limited-evidence abstention can miss source-established findings while retaining uncertainty credit.
Candidate-specific visibility was not inspected. Statements about what a candidate was supplied are not treated as global claims that source records do not exist.
Exact evidence strings were checked against their declared source or explicitly labeled summary. Non-exact translated evidence is a citation issue even when its substantive meaning is supported.
A useful next step need not satisfy every action criterion. No model ranking, arm attribution, causal effect, production claim or expenditure conclusion follows from this review.
